items.description: AtlasRAT is being delivered through a fake Flash Player installer that looks harmless but can give attackers remote control of a Windows computer. The campaign abuses a familiar software name to lower a victim’s guard, then loads much of its malicious code directly into memory, where it is harder for traditional file-based checks to catch. Instead of behaving like typical malware, the operators turned a trusted Linux security feature into a tool for covering their tracks.
